[EN] I thought we had them routed, but they've pushed us back!

Those Atel Akaad...things...are terrifying.

If we don't get rid of them now, we're sure to be crushed.
[ES] ¡Pensé que los teníamos dispersados, pero nos han hecho retroceder!

Esas cosas de Atel Akaad... son terroríficas.

Si no nos deshacemos de ellos ahora, seguro que seremos aplastados.
